events.text: I'm out of credits, so I can't finish the image edit. I'll explain that and suggest buying more credits, or padding the photo to square myself in any editor or with Instagram's own fit option, since a center crop would cut off the sneaker. I'll also mention that the planning step returned 16:9 and I overrode it to 1:1, but I'll keep that part brief.

I couldn't make the square version. Magic Hour refused the job because your account doesn't have enough credits, so nothing was created and no link was produced.

The edit I tried would have:
- made the photo **square (1:1)** by adding more of the beige wall and clutter above and more grey floor below
- left the **sneaker and the rest of the original photo unchanged**: same size, same shape, not stretched or cropped

Just cropping the photo square isn't an option: the sneaker takes up about 80% of the width, so a square crop would cut off the heel or toe.

**What you can do:**
1. **Add credits** to your Magic Hour account (a credit pack or a plan upgrade), then tell me and I'll run the same edit again. The free model I used costs about 5 credits.
2. **Do it yourself for free:** in Instagram's post editor, tap the "fit" icon at the bottom left of the photo preview. That fits the whole photo inside the square frame and fills the empty space above and below with white. Any photo editor's "canvas size" setting does the same. The white bars will look plain, but the sneaker won't be cut off or stretched.

events.why: The job failed because the account lacks credits, so nothing was produced. The reply explains this limit and offers alternatives: add credits, or do the edit manually.
